concept.title: Checking the Hybrid Starter & Generator (HSG) belt

conbody.p: Have the Hybrid Starter & Generator (HSG) belt inspected or replaced according to the Maintenance Schedule in this chapter by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

note.p: When the HSG belt is worn out or damaged, replace the belt. Otherwise, it may cause engine overheating or battery discharge.

li.p: Turn the vehicle off while you inspect the engine or Hybrid Starter & Generator (HSG) belt. Otherwise it may result in serious injury.
Keep hands, clothing etc. away from the Hybrid Starter & Generator (HSG) belt
